title: Founder Associate (Berlin)
description:
Who we are

Foundation models transformed text and images. Structured data - the largest and most consequential data format in the world - stayed untouched, until now. What LLMs did for language, we're doing for tables.

We pioneered tabular foundation models: TabPFN v2 was a Nature cover story, has passed 3.5M+ downloads and 7,500+ GitHub stars, and runs in production from detecting lung disease with Oxford Cancer Analytics to preventing train failures with Hitachi. The hardest problems - millions of rows, real-time inference, entirely new modalities - are still open, and no one else is working on them at this level.

We're a small, highly selective team of 40+ with backgrounds from Google, DeepMind, Meta, Apple, Amazon, Jane Street, and CERN, led by Frank Hutter, Noah Hollmann, and Sauraj Gambhir, and advised by Bernhard Schölkopf and Turing Award winner Yann LeCun.

In July 2026, less than 18 months after our €9M pre-seed, we joined SAP as an independent frontier AI lab - same team, mission, and open-weights models, now backed by more than €1 billion over four years.

About the Role

As our Founder Associate, you sit in the founders' office and work directly with the founders and Chief of Staff to shape and execute the initiatives that drive Prior Labs' growth. You get real ownership of business functions, with broad exposure across the company, from strategy to execution.

We run our business functions with defined areas of ownership: Growth, Sales & Enablement, Marketing & Community, and People Ops. You pick up ownership across these areas based on what the company needs and where you're strongest, and you go deep where you have the most impact.

Everything we do is AI-first, so you'll spend less time on the grunt work and more time building the systems that make it obsolete.

Core Areas of Impact

Below are examples of what you could own:

Growth

Leads that reach Prior Labs get qualified, enriched, scored, and routed automatically. You own that engine, make it better, and find the next channel.

  • Own the inbound pipeline end to end

  • Remove the manual steps that are left: better scoring, smarter routing, more automation

  • Build the pipeline reporting the founders and sales team actually use

  • Test new channels: data sources, outbound angles, our first paid experiments

  • Own tracking and attribution, so we know where pipeline actually comes from

Sales Enablement

Our sales team talks to some of the largest companies in the world. You build everything around their conversations so they can focus on selling.

  • Automate call prep: short briefings so no one walks into a call cold

  • Own decks, case studies, battle cards, and demo assets

  • Keep POCs on track: milestones, follow-ups, next steps

  • Turn closed deals into reference stories and case studies

Ops & Automation

We think most internal work can be automated with today's AI, and your job is to do it.

  • Pick the most annoying recurring workflow each month and automate it

  • Build agents and automations across our stack: HRIS, CRM, Notion, Slack

  • Own the internal tooling landscape: what we use, how it connects

  • Prototype fast: a working script this week over a perfect system next quarter

  • Ship things the whole company uses daily

Expansion & People Ops

We're doubling headcount across 2 countries, and everything behind that is being built right now. If you're obsessed with people, culture, and process building, this is your playground.

  • Help open our new offices and set up new countries

  • Own onboarding end to end, from signed contract to a solid first week

  • Take clunky people processes, redesign it, ship it

  • Make our HRIS the single source of truth, with automations doing the boring parts

  • Run the operational side of hiring: scheduling, candidate communication, interview logistics

What We're Looking For

You're a resourceful, adaptable, and self-driven builder who thrives in a fast-paced startup environment. We're looking for someone with the potential to grow into a future leader of the company. You have:

Essential Background

  • A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business Administration, Computer Science, Data Science, or a related field, or you've done the work without the credential

  • 1-2 years of experience in consulting, venture capital, start-ups or similar roles

  • An AI-first way of working: you try new tools the moment they come out, you know where they save time, and you know where your own judgment still has to take over

  • High agency: you ship a v1 quickly, iterate, and don't wait for a brief to figure out what needs doing

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a focus on execution

  • Structured and reliable: when you own something, it's handled

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, in English

What Makes You Special

  • Experience working in or with early-stage startups

  • You've built automations, agents, or internal tools that people actually used

  • Background in machine learning, data science, or related technical fields

  • Familiarity with open source, foundation models, or data science ecosystems

  • Proven ability to manage cross-functional projects or initiatives

  • Interest or experience in sales enablement, content creation, or community building

Location

  • Berlin, a global tech hub and one of Europe's most dynamic cities

  • On-site

Benefits

  • Competitive compensation package

  • 30 days of paid vacation + public holidays

  • Comprehensive benefits including healthcare, transportation, and fitness

  • Real ownership from day one, with a manager who has time for you

  • An AI-first way of working, with the tooling and budget to match

  • Work with state-of-the-art ML architecture, substantial resources and a world-class team

Life at Prior Labs

You'll work alongside researchers and builders who hold themselves to a very high bar - in the quality of their work and in how they work with each other. We move fast and still take the time to do things right.

Our teams are based in Berlin, Freiburg, and New York - when you're working on something as hard as TabPFN, being in the same room matters. But great people come from everywhere, and in exceptional cases we're open to remote, which usually means frequent travel to one of our offices. Wherever you're based, the whole company comes together regularly for offsites to build and celebrate together.

Our Commitments

The best products and teams are built by people with a wide range of perspectives and backgrounds. We welcome applications from all identities and walks of life - especially if you've ever felt discouraged by "not checking every box" - and provide equal opportunities regardless of gender, sexual orientation, origin, disability, or any other trait that makes you who you are.

title: Immobilienmakler (m/w/d) – Schwerpunkt Vermietung | Werkstudent oder Teilzeit
description:
Warum LPE Immobilien?

  • Du wirst eingearbeitet, bevor du loslegst. Die ersten Wochen läufst du mit, schaust zu und übernimmst Schritt für Schritt. Erst wenn du sicher bist, bekommst du eigene Objekte — nicht am ersten Tag.
  • Du lernst den Markt an der schnellsten Stelle kennen. Vermietung ist der Bereich, in dem man am schnellsten versteht, wie Immobilien funktionieren: warum sich eine Wohnung in drei Tagen vermietet und die im selben Haus in sechs Wochen nicht.
  • Du sprichst selbst mit Kunden. Interessenten, Mieter, Eigentümer. Du bist vor Ort das Gesicht von LPE und nicht die Stimme im Hintergrund.
  • Du hast einen festen Ansprechpartner. Ein Makler aus dem Team begleitet dich, gibt dir Rückmeldung und übernimmt, wenn ein Fall komplizierter wird. Fragen zu stellen ist bei uns kein Zeichen von Schwäche, sondern Teil des Jobs.
  • Wir entwickeln unsere Makler selbst. Wer bei uns lernt und liefert, hat nach dem Studium eine Perspektive.
  • Du arbeitest mit Software, die es sonst nicht gibt. Unser eigenes System lpeOS bildet Prozesse ab, für die andere Unternehmen noch mit Excel-Listen und Papierordnern arbeiten.


Was dich bei uns erwartet – Deine Aufgaben

  • Du organisierst die Vermarktung einer Einheit. Fototermin mit unseren Fotografen abstimmen und begleiten, Exposé erstellen, Inserat veröffentlichen und aktuell halten. Beim Exposé unterstützt dich unser Marketing.
  • Du kümmerst dich um die Interessenten. Anfragen sichten und vorqualifizieren, Termine koordinieren, Besichtigungen durchführen und nachfassen. Auch dann, wenn auf ein Objekt vierzig Anfragen kommen.
  • Du bereitest die Mieterauswahl vor. Unterlagen auf Vollständigkeit prüfen, Bonitätsnachweise sichten und deine Einschätzung zu den Bewerbern abgeben. Die finale Entscheidung trefft ihr gemeinsam.
  • Du unterstützt bei Abnahmen und Übergaben: Protokolle vorbereiten, Zählerstände erfassen, Mängel dokumentieren, Schlüssel übergeben.
  • Du hältst die Daten sauber. Jeder Kontakt, jeder Termin, jeder Status im System. Das klingt unspektakulär und ist die Grundlage dafür, dass bei uns nichts verloren geht.
  • Du arbeitest den Maklern zu. Termine vorbereiten, Objektunterlagen zusammenstellen, Korrespondenz übernehmen, bei Interessenten und Dienstleistern nachfassen. Vieles davon lernst du dabei nebenbei — weil du siehst, wie ein erfahrener Makler einen Fall aufbaut.
  • Du übernimmst Backoffice-Aufgaben. Stammdaten pflegen, Unterlagen digitalisieren und ablegen, Prozesse dokumentieren. Wie viel das ist, hängt von der Auslastung ab — planbar besprechen wir das jede Woche.


Was du mitbringen solltest

  • Du gehst offen auf Menschen zu. Eine Besichtigung mit acht fremden Leuten zu führen, muss dir liegen. Perfekt sein musst du dabei am Anfang nicht.
  • Du hast ein Gespür für Menschen — oder willst es entwickeln. Bei der Mieterauswahl zählt nicht nur die Bonität, und genau dieses Urteil lernst du bei uns.
  • Du bist gut organisiert. Mehrere Objekte, Termine und Fristen parallel: Wer hier den Überblick verliert, verliert auch den guten Mieter.
  • Du arbeitest zuverlässig. Interessenten stehen sonst vor verschlossener Tür, und das kostet uns beim Eigentümer mehr als jeder Fehler im Exposé.
  • Du fragst nach, statt zu raten — bei Kunden genauso wie im Team.
  • Du bist eingeschrieben oder suchst eine Teilzeitstelle. Die Studienrichtung ist zweitrangig, kaufmännisches oder immobilienwirtschaftliches Interesse hilft.
  • Du lernst Software schnell und denkst digital.

Vorerfahrung in der Immobilienbranche brauchst du nicht. Das Handwerk bringen wir dir bei.


Was wir dir bieten

  • Einarbeitung. Du läufst mit, bekommst deine Aufgaben schrittweise und arbeitest ab dem ersten Tag mit jemandem zusammen, den du alles fragen kannst.
  • Aufgaben, die dich weiterbringen. Du machst keine Ablage und keine Kaffeeküche, sondern Arbeit, die im Lebenslauf etwas bedeutet und die du im nächsten Bewerbungsgespräch erklären kannst.
  • Perspektive nach dem Studium. Wer bei uns lernt und liefert, bekommt eine Zukunft und nicht nur ein Zeugnis.
  • Persönliche Weiterentwicklung. Wohin du dich entwickeln willst, besprechen wir offen und regelmäßig — und wir sorgen dafür, dass du die Aufgaben und die Unterstützung bekommst, die dich dorthin bringen.
  • Gelebte Feedback-Kultur. Feedback ist das schnellste Werkzeug, das wir haben, um besser zu werden. Deshalb geben wir es sofort und nicht einmal im Jahr. Das gilt in beide Richtungen: Du bekommst ehrliche Rückmeldung — und wir erwarten sie genauso von dir.
  • Planbarkeit im Semester. Vorlesungszeiten und Klausurphasen stimmen wir im Voraus ab, statt sie zum Problem zu machen. Besichtigungen liegen ohnehin häufig am späten Nachmittag.
  • Modernste Ausstattung: Premium-Hardware, cloudbasierte Tools, papierlos.
  • e-Mobilität inklusive: internes E-Carsharing für Termine und private Erledigungen.

  • Die Geschäftsführung in Meetings, gegenüber Team Leads und extern vertreten.


Dein Profil

  • Deutsch auf C2-Niveau und wohnhaft in München
  • Echte Startup-Erfahrung: Im Aufbau (z.B. Venture Building, Early Stage, Wachstums-Phase) – kein Corporate-Hintergrund.

  • KPI-fokussiert: Du steuerst mit Zahlen, nicht mit Bauchgefühl.
  • Persönlichkeit: Hungrig, hohe Arbeitsbereitschaft, Lust auf Aufbauen unter Unsicherheit.

title: Senior Finance Manager (all genders)
description:
Your role

About FRASER 

FRASER is an independent creative agency with teams across Berlin, Zurich, Cape Town and Dubai. We develop integrated campaigns, content and digital experiences for ambitious international brands, combining strategic thinking, creativity and technology. As we continue to grow, we're building scalable operations to support our international business. 

 Your role 

  • Take ownership of the finance function across FRASER, ensuring accurate financial reporting and efficient day-to-day financial operations.  
  • Prepare monthly management accounts, budgets, cash flow forecasts and financial analyses to support business decisions.  
  • Oversee accounts payable, accounts receivable, banking, payment runs, reconciliations and liquidity planning.  
  • Coordinate the preparation of bookkeeping (Vorbereitende Buchhaltung), ensuring invoices, purchase orders and supporting documentation are complete and accurate before submission to external accounting partners. 
  • Work closely with our external accounting firms in Germany, Switzerland, South Africa and Dubai, ensuring smooth collaboration and timely financial processes. 
  • Coordinate month-end and year-end closing activities together with external accountants and tax advisors.  
  • Ensure compliance with German accounting, tax and statutory requirements while supporting finance processes across our international locations.  
  • Collaborate closely with the Managing Directors and Founder on budgeting, forecasting, profitability and business performance.  
  • Identify opportunities to improve financial processes, reporting and operational efficiency.  
  • Help build and scale the finance function, with the opportunity to grow into the Head of Finance role as the company continues to expand. 


Your profile


  • Degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration or a related field.  
  • 5+ years of experience in finance, accounting, controlling or financial management.  
  • Strong understanding of German accounting, bookkeeping and financial regulations.  
  • Experience with vorbereitender Buchhaltung, including invoice verification, purchase order management and coordination with external accountants.  
  • Previous experience within a creative agency, marketing agency or professional services environment is a strong advantage.  
  • Experience working with multiple international entities is a plus. 
  • Excellent organisational skills and a structured, hands-on approach.  
  • Strong analytical thinking and attention to detail.  
  • DATEV experience is an advantage.  
  • Advanced Excel skills.  
  • Fluent English is essential. German should be at least professional working proficiency, with a solid understanding of German accounting terminology.  
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial and international environment. 


What we offer

  • The opportunity to shape a globally relevant social media arm of a growing agency with relevant big clients and substantial business 
  • A senior leadership team that is close and passionately ambitious  
  • Fantastic colleagues and a collaborative environment
  • Competitive salary 
  • Employee benefits program 
  • Chance to help shape the agency and influence its growth 
  • Flat hierarchy fostering a transparent and collaborative work culture 
  • International environment with diverse employees, clients, and locations 
  • Experienced team: work alongside seasoned professionals 
  • 30 days of vacation per year (based on a 5-day workweek) 
  • Opportunity for workation from European countries or South Africa 
  • Flexible working hours and locations, including 3 days on site in our great office and 2 home office 
  • A great roof terrace in the heart of Kreuzberg and always a fridge full of cool drinks 

We are an equal opportunity employer. This role, like all at FRASER, is open to talent regardless of age, creed, gender, or race. We hire for ability and skill. And we look forward to getting to know you.

Um diesen Datensatz systematisch auszubauen und zu härten und damit die Grundlage, auf der unsere Algorithmen gemessen werden, zu entwickeln, suchen wir dich als Werkstudent Data QA & Algorithm Benchmarking (m/w/d) zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt in Münster. 

Deine Aufgaben

  • Ground Truth Audit: Du evaluierst die Korrektheit bestehender Testdaten und ermittelst hierfür neue Metriken, die wir zur Evaluation unserer Algorithmen verwenden können.
  • Edge Cases jagen: Du ermittelst neue Testdaten für schwierige Gebäude (z.B. komplexe Dachformen, Bäume über den Dächern) und integrierst diese in den Gesamtdatensatz.
  • Data Sourcing: Du ermittelst potenzielle Quellen für neue Testdatensätze und integrierst diese möglichst automatisiert.

Deine Aufgaben

Worum es bei uns gerade geht

Marketing-Daten werden komplexer und gleichzeitig wichtiger für Geschäftsentscheidungen. Cookieless, AI Overviews, Predictive Analytics, KI-gestützte Auswertungen, denn das alte Tracking-Handwerk reicht nicht mehr.
Bei uns ist das längst Tagesgeschäft. Wir beraten unsere Kund:innen zu Datenstrategie, KI-gestützten Auswertungen und Marketing-Analytics in laufenden Projekten und in der Akquise. Unseren MarTech-Bereich entwickeln wir konsequent weiter, eng verzahnt mit SEO, SEA, Social und allen anderen Online-Marketing-Disziplinen.
Für diesen Bereich suchen wir eine erfahrene Person, die Beratung, Akquise und Auslieferung in einer Hand verbindet. Wie sich der Bereich entwickelt und welche Schwerpunkte er bekommt, definierst du selbst auf einem Spielfeld mit Anschluss an alle relevanten deutschen Branchen und Kundengrößen.

Was du bei uns machst

  • Du verantwortest unseren MarTech-Bereich: Audits, KPI-Frameworks, Marketing-Dashboards, Datenstrategie und Storytelling für unsere Kund:innen
  • Du übernimmst die Beratung eigener Kund:innen, strategisch, methodisch und operativ
  • Du bist Sparring-Partner:in für die Projektmanager:innen, wenn es darum geht, datengetriebene Themen beim Kunden zu platzieren
  • Du bringst deine Expertise in Pitches, Ausschreibungen und Angebote ein, gemeinsam mit den PMs und unserem Partner- und Portfolio-Team
  • Du übersetzt Analytics-Erkenntnisse in Datenstorytelling und C-Level-Kommunikation
  • Predictive Marketing, Marketing Mix Modelling, KI-gestützte Analyse, du erschließt diese Felder selbst und kannst sie zu eigenen Service-Angeboten ausbauen

Wie wir arbeiten

  • Stabsstelle direkt bei der Geschäftsführung, kurze Wege, volle fachliche Verantwortung, ohne Linienhierarchie
  • Wir arbeiten ohne Micro-Management. Wir messen die Wirkung deiner Arbeit, nicht deine Stunden
  • KI ist fester Bestandteil unserer Arbeit, kein Selbstzweck
  • Akquise findet im Team statt: bei Pitches und Ausschreibungen unterstützen dich die PMs und unser Partner- und Portfolio-Team. Klassische Kaltakquise gehört nicht zum Job
  • Entscheidungen treffen wir gemeinsam und transparent

Wie der Job konkret aussieht

  • Du arbeitest an mehreren Kundenprojekten parallel, mit unterschiedlichsten Branchen, Geschäftsmodellen und Datenquellen, vom E-Commerce-Forecasting bis zur B2B-Lead-Attribution
  • Du bist regelmäßig im direkten Austausch mit Kund:innen und PMs
  • Du gestaltest aktiv die MarTech-Außendarstellung und das Service-Portfolio mit
  • Pilotprojekte für neue Felder (Predictive, MMM, KI-gestützte Analyse) kannst du selbst definieren und ihren Aufbau aktiv gestalten

Das bringst du mit

  • Mind. 4 Jahre Erfahrung in einer beratungsnahen Rolle in Online-Marketing, Web Analytics, Data Analytics oder MarTech
  • Nachweisbare Erfahrung in der Konzeption und Umsetzung von KPI-Frameworks und Marketing-Dashboards
  • Fundierte Kenntnisse in GA4 oder einer vergleichbaren Analytics-Plattform (Matomo, etracker)
  • Praktische Erfahrung mit Looker Studio und BigQuery
  • Konzeptionelles Verständnis von Server Side Tracking und cookielosen Ansätzen; eigene operative Erfahrung von Vorteil
  • Deutschkenntnisse mind. C1

Du suchst eine Rolle, die fachliche Tiefe mit Beratung und Kundennähe verbindet, von Audits bis zu C-Level-Gesprächen. Reines Spezialistentum ohne Kundenkontakt ist hier nicht der Job.
Du musst nicht alles können. Das Feld ist breit, die Tiefe in einzelnen Disziplinen kann variieren, entscheidend ist, dass du das Geschäft verstehst, beratungsfähig bist und neue Themen selbst erschließt.

Unser Versprechen an dich

  • Eigenverantwortliche MarTech-Beratung mit Definitionsfreiheit

title: Safety Inspector (m/w/d)
description:
Bei FlixTrain gestaltest du die Zukunft der Mobilität aktiv mit. Wir bieten dir nicht nur sichere Arbeitsplätze sowie attraktive Zusatzleistungen, sondern auch ein dynamisches, internationales Umfeld, in dem deine Ideen echten Einfluss haben.

Bei FlixTrain hat Sicherheit im Eisenbahnbetrieb oberste Priorität. Als Safety Inspector stellst du die Überwachung der im Fahrdienst eingesetzten Betriebsdienstmitarbeitenden gemäß den Vorgaben der FlixTrain GmbH sicher, führst Prüfungen durch und sorgst dafür, dass Regelwerke konsequent umgesetzt werden - im Alltag wie in Ausnahmesituationen. Du agierst mit hoher Fachkompetenz, Fingerspitzengefühl und klarer Haltung an der Schnittstelle zwischen Betrieb, Mitarbeitenden und Behörden.

Über die Rolle

  • Du führst Betriebskontrollen und Überwachungsfahrten durch und wertest Fahrdaten gemäß den Sicherheitszielen aus
  • Das Qualifikationsmanagement inklusive Führung der „Betrieblichen Akte" der im Fahrdienst eingesetzten Betriebsdienstmitarbeitenden liegt in deiner Hand
  • Mitfahrberechtigungen sowie Strecken- und Ortskenntnis-Erwerbsaufträge gibst du aus und verwaltest die zugehörigen Zusatzbescheinigungen
  • Per Stichprobe kontrollierst du Dienstpläne und Schichten hinsichtlich der Einhaltung von Lenk- und Ruhezeiten sowie der Planungsvorgaben gemäß BRW
  • Bei Unfall- und Ereignisuntersuchungen wirkst du mit, übernimmst den EVU-Notdienst und agierst als Prüfer:in gemäß Prüfungsordnung der FlixTrain GmbH
  • An der Weiterentwicklung des Sicherheitsmanagementsystems und des Regelwerks arbeitest du aktiv mit und pflegst die Safety-internen digitalen Anwendungen
  • Im Rahmen der ECM-Aufgaben überprüfst du die Einhaltung gesetzlicher und ECM-interner Vorgaben für den betriebssicheren Einsatz der Fahrzeuge

Über Dich

  • Du bringst einen Triebfahrzeugführerschein mit gültiger Zusatzbescheinigung sowie mindestens drei Jahre Berufserfahrung (ohne Anrechnung der Ausbildungszeit) mit
  • Das eisenbahnbetriebliche Regelwerk beherrschst du sehr sicher, idealerweise inklusive europäischer Regelungen und des grenznahen Auslands
  • Eine Tauglichkeit gemäß TfV und mindestens ein Realschulabschluss sind bei dir gegeben, sowie nachweisbare Deutschkenntnisse mindestens C1-Niveau
  • Mit mindestens 100 Fahrstunden als Triebfahrzeugführer:in im Kalenderjahr und einem PKW-Führerschein bist du bestens aufgestellt
  • Deutschlandweit bist du gerne unterwegs und zeigst Bereitschaft zur Arbeit an Wochenenden, Feiertagen und nachts sowie zur Übernahme von Rufbereitschaften
  • Im Umgang mit Reisenden und sicherheitsrelevanten Situationen bist du erfahren
  • Ausgeprägte kommunikative Sensibilität im Umgang mit Mitarbeitenden und Behörden zeichnet dich aus

Bei uns zählt der Blick auf das Ganze – auch wenn du nicht alle Anforderungen zu 100 % erfüllst, aber dennoch glaubst, etwas bewegen zu können, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung! 

Was Wir Bieten

  • Mobilität: Mit deiner BahnCard100 bist du jederzeit flexibel unterwegs - auch in deiner Freizeit.  
  • Reisevorteile: 12 kostenlose Flix-Gutscheine + 12 Rabattgutscheine für Freunde & Familie.
  • Arbeiten von Überall: Je nach Rolle kannst du bis zu 60 Tage pro Jahr von einem anderen Standort aus arbeiten.
  • Hybrides Arbeitsmodell: Wir sind ein Unternehmen mit Bürokultur, bieten jedoch Flexibilität, um Arbeit und Leben in Einklang zu bringen.
  • Gesundheits- und Wohlfühlangebote: Zugang zu vertraulichen Einzelberatungen, Kursen und Stressbewältigungsmaßnahmen - für dich und bis zu vier Familienangehörige.
  • Lernen & Entwicklung: Nutze Sprachkurse, Schulungen und Experten-Sessions, um deine Fähigkeiten auszubauen.
  • Mentoring-Programm: Vernetze dich mit erfahrenen Kollegen, um Einblicke zu gewinnen und deine Karriere zu beschleunigen.

Warum Teil von Flix werden? 

Bei Flix konzentrieren wir uns darauf, Reisen einfach, sicher und erschwinglich zu gestalten - sowohl für unsere Passagiere als auch für unsere Mitarbeiter. Hier geht es schnell voran, und es gibt viel Raum, etwas zu bewegen. Wir wachsen und entwickeln uns täglich weiter und suchen Menschen, die bereit sind, sich einzubringen und die Art und Weise, wie wir arbeiten, mitzugestalten. 

Wenn du einen Job suchst, in dem du wachsen und etwas bewirken kannst, dann bist du bei FlixTrain genau richtig. Hier kannst du Teil eines Teams werden, in dem dein Beitrag zählt und du deine Reise selbst gestalten kannst!

title: Senior UX / Digital Product Designer (Mensch), Schwerpunkt FinTech
description:
Wir suchen eine:n in Teilzeit oder Vollzeit, im Frankfurter Raum oder mit hoher Reisebereitschaft einen Senior UX / Digital Product Designer (Mensch) mit Schwerpunkt FinTech, der:die den gesamten Prozess digitaler Produktentwicklung souverän beherrscht und Projekte in dynamischen Kontexten und Projektumfeldern eigenverantwortlich führen kann und sowohl strategisch als auch operativ auf Senior-Niveau agiert.

Taikonauten entwickelt digitale Produkte, Services und Plattformen für Organisationen aus Branchen wie Finance, FinTech, Mobility sowie Industrial & Manufacturing. Wir unterstützen Unternehmen dabei, ihre digitalen Angebote im Kontext von digitaler Transformation, Produktinnovation und Acceleration strategisch und nachhaltig weiterzuentwickeln. Dabei arbeiten wir explorativ, konzeptionell tief und mit hohem gestalterischem Anspruch – immer mit starkem Fokus auf Nutzerzentrierung.

Unser Anspruch ist es, Produkte von der ersten Problemdefinition bis zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung im Markt zu begleiten. Neben fachlicher Expertise ist uns vor allem der menschliche Match wichtig. Wenn du Begeisterung für digitale Produktentwicklung mitbringst und aktiv an anspruchsvollen Projekten mitwirken möchtest, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung.

Deine Mission

Du führst digitale Produktentwicklungen mit konzeptioneller Klarheit, methodischer Sicherheit und gestalterischer Exzellenz. Du bringst Struktur in komplexe und zunächst unklare Problemstellungen, triffst fundierte Designentscheidungen und argumentierst diese gegenüber Kund:innen und internen Teams. Dabei übernimmst du Verantwortung – nicht nur für Screens, sondern für Produktqualität, Nutzerzentrierung und Projektdynamik. Du verbindest Business-Ziele mit echten Nutzerbedürfnissen und führst Projekte von der Discovery-Phase bis zur Validierung. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit Kund:innen, Entwickler:innen und interdisziplinären Teams zusammen und setzt Qualitätsmaßstäbe in UX, Visual Design und konzeptioneller Klarheit.

Aufgaben

  • Verantwortung für den gesamten UX- und Product-Design-Prozess (Discovery bis Delivery)
  • Strukturierung unscharfer Problemstellungen (Problem Framing, Scope, Hypothesen)
  • Einbringung deiner fachlichen Perspektive und deines Beratungsstils in der Zusammenarbeit mit Kund:innen
  • Entwicklung tragfähiger UX-Konzepte für komplexe digitale Produkte
  • Erstellung von Informationsarchitekturen, User Journeys und End-to-End-Flows
  • Übersetzung von Anforderungen in testbare UX-Spezifikationen
  • Planung und Durchführung qualitativer Research-Formate (Interviews, Tests, Workshops)
  • Strukturierte Synthese von Insights und Ableitung belastbarer Empfehlungen
  • Konzeption und Ausarbeitung visuell hochwertiger UI-Designs und Design-Systeme
  • Moderation von Workshops zur Projektinitialisierung, Zielbilddefinition und Priorisierung
  • Argumentative Vertretung von UX- und Designentscheidungen gegenüber Stakeholdern
  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Development-Teams während der Umsetzung
  • Eigenständige Strukturierung komplexer Projektphasen

Qualifikation

Erfahrung & Kompetenz

  • Langjährige Erfahrung im UX / Product Design (5+ Jahre)
  • Mehrjährige Agenturerfahrung mit parallelen Projekten und wechselnden Kunden
  • Fundierte Expertise in fachlich-strategischer UX-Konzeption
  • Nachweisbare End-to-End-Erfahrung in digitaler Produktentwicklung
  • Fundierte Expertise in User Research und quantitativer/qualitativer Analyse
  • Fähigkeit, datenbasierte Hypothesen abzuleiten und zu validieren
  • Sehr hoher Anspruch an visuelle Qualität (Layout, Typografie, Design-Systeme)
  • Strategisches Verständnis von Digital Strategy und Service Design
  • Souveräne Moderation auf Deutsch (mindestens B2, idealerweise C1)
  • Sicherer Umgang mit Figma

title: Treasury Manager (m/w/d)
description:
Über uns

Wir sind ju:niz Energy – seit mehr als einem Jahrzehnt Pionierin für netzdienliche Batteriegroßspeicher. Von der Projektentwicklung über Bau und Vermarktung bis zum langfristigen Betrieb verbinden wir alle entscheidenden Kompetenzen unter einem Dach. Unser Ziel: eine der führenden BESS-Plattformen Deutschlands aufzubauen und die Energiewende mit leistungsstarker Speicherinfrastruktur messbar voranzubringen.

Eine wachsende Projektpipeline braucht jederzeit Transparenz über Liquidität, Verpflichtungen und Finanzierungsspielräume. Als Treasury Manager steuerst du unsere operativen Treasury-Prozesse, entwickelst das Cash Management weiter und schaffst eine belastbare Verbindung zwischen Banken, Projektfinanzierungen und interner Planung. Damit sicherst du nicht nur den Zahlungsverkehr, sondern aktiv unsere Wachstumsfähigkeit.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Den konzernweiten Zahlungsverkehr, die Bankkonten sowie Zeichnungs- und Berechtigungsstrukturen steuerst du sicher und effizient.
  • Kurzfristige Liquiditätspositionen behältst du jederzeit im Blick und entwickelst gemeinsam mit FP&A einen belastbaren Cashflow-Forecast.
  • Corporate Debt, Exportfinanzierungen und weitere Finanzierungslösungen betreust du von der Vorbereitung bis zur laufenden Umsetzung.
  • Auszahlungen, Capital Calls sowie Zins- und Gebührenzahlungen koordinierst du verlässlich und sorgst für vollständige Dokumentation.
  • Avalen, Bürgschaften und Letters of Credit managst du ebenso wie kurzfristige Investments und relevante Bankbeziehungen.
  • Covenants, Bankreportings und finanzielle Verpflichtungen überwachst du vorausschauend; auch Zins-, Währungs- und Hedging-Themen entwickelst du weiter.
  • Treasury-Prozesse, Kontrollen und Systemunterstützung professionalisierst du in enger Abstimmung mit Accounting, FP&A, Tax und Finance Transformation.

Dein Profil

  • Du hast ein Studium in Finance, Betriebswirtschaft, Banking oder einem vergleichbaren Fachgebiet abgeschlossen.

We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here.

We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence.

Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology.

AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen.

 

About the team

 

Our National Security and AI Safety business unit is dedicated to advancing the responsible development and deployment of AI in support of national security and global stability. From strengthening mission-critical capabilities across national security and intelligence, to working with frontier labs to provide robust AI safety red teaming and evaluation, we work at the frontier of high-stakes, high-impact missions.

We understand that powerful AI systems bring both transformative opportunities and complex risks and we are proud to partner with Government and the biggest tech organisations in the world to ensure AI is not just transformative but is also secure, trustworthy and safe for all.

 

About the role

 

As a Customer Director at Faculty, you will serve as a trusted partner and strategic lead for the largest technology and lab clients, advancing the frontier of safe, trustworthy, and audit-ready AI systems. Blending deep technical credibility with delivery leadership, you will guide government bodies, Frontier labs, and high-impact organisations through complex AI safety, evaluation, and red-teaming challenges.

You will own key client relationships, drive commercial strategy, and oversee multidisciplinary delivery teams to ensure cutting-edge AI deployments are secure, reliable, and grounded in real-world impact.

 

What you'll be doing:

 

  • Leading strategic accounts across AI frontier labs, hyperscalers and government entities to build long-term partnerships focused on robust AI safety, evaluation, and red teaming.

  • Designing transformation programmes that integrate advanced AI evaluation methodologies, auditing frameworks, and technical standards directly into mission-critical operations.

  • Partnering with senior client leaders to translate complex safety, governance, and technical AI concepts into actionable strategy and impactful programmes.

  • Overseeing delivery excellence across cross-functional teams of engineers, researchers, and delivery leads to ensure high-stakes projects succeed.

  • Developing commercial strategies and proposals that expand our work across safety-critical domains while meeting ambitious growth goals.

  • Championing thought leadership by sharing insights on AI safety frameworks, emerging risk evaluation, and industry standards with senior stakeholders

 

Who we're looking for:

 

  • You bring deep expertise in AI safety, auditing, ethics, or evaluation methodologies, developed through time in government, research labs, or tech-forward environments.

  • You are delivery-focused and technically credible, with a track record of translating complex AI and data-oriented concepts into clear strategies for technical senior leaders.

  • You have a proven track record of building trusted, long-term relationships with senior stakeholders and navigating strategic commercial conversations with confidence.

  • You excel as a collaborative leader, capable of inspiring multidisciplinary teams and bringing together technicians and delivery leads toward a shared mission.

  • You possess an entrepreneurial mindset, with the curiosity and drive to identify emerging opportunities and solve ambiguous, high-stakes challenges.

  • You are adaptable and outcome-driven, bringing the strategic vision needed to help partners navigate the rapidly changing AI safety landscape.

 

The Interview Process

 

  1. Talent Team Screen (30 minutes)

  2. Introduction to the team (60 minutes)

  3. Discovery Role Play Interview (60 minutes)

  4. Commercial Leadership Interview (60 minutes)

#LI-PRIO

Our Recruitment Ethos

We aim to grow the best team - not the most similar one. We know that diversity of individuals fosters diversity of thought, and that strengthens our principle of seeking truth. And we know from experience that diverse teams deliver better work, relevant to the world in which we live. We’re united by a deep intellectual curiosity and desire to use our abilities for measurable positive impact. We strongly encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, religions and sexual orientations.

Some of our standout benefits:

  • Unlimited Annual Leave Policy

  • Private healthcare and dental

  • Enhanced parental leave

  • Family-Friendly Flexibility & Flexible working

  • Sanctus Coaching

  • Hybrid Working

If you don’t feel you meet all the requirements, but are excited by the role and know you bring some key strengths, please don't hesitate in applying as you might be right for this role, or other roles. We are open to conversations about part-time hours.

A note on AI: we're happy for you to use it for research and interview prep, but please don't use it to generate answers during live interviews. We also use an AI note-taker (Metaview) in interviews so interviewers can stay present (which you can opt out of just let us know,) and every application is reviewed by a human, never decided by AI.

description:
About Us

At LangChain, our mission is to make intelligent agents ubiquitous. We build the foundation for agent engineering in the real world, helping developers move from prototypes to production-ready AI agents that teams can rely on. We began as widely adopted open-source tools and have grown to also offer a platform for building, evaluating, deploying, and operating agents at scale.

With $125M raised at Series B from IVP, Sequoia, Benchmark, CapitalG, and Sapphire Ventures, we’re at a stage where we’re continuing to develop new products, growth is accelerating, and all team members have meaningful impact on what we build and how we work together. LangChain is a place where your contributions can shape how this technology shows up in the real world.

Today, our platform includes LangSmith (Observability, Evaluation, Deployment, Fleet, and Sandboxes), our open source frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, and Deep Agents), and the newly launched LangSmith Engine for autonomous agent improvement. We have 100M+ monthly open source downloads, 6,000+ active LangSmith customers, and 5 of the Fortune 10 use LangSmith in production (+ 35% of the Fortune 500 overall), including teams at Klarna, Clay, Coinbase, Workday, Lyft, Cloudflare, Harvey, Rippling, Vanta, LinkedIn, Monday.com, Nvidia, and Bridgewater.

title: GTM
description:
We're Heidi

We're building the future of healthcare by giving every clinician the earth's finest AI Care Partner. In just 18 months, our clinical AI products have absorbed the administrative chaos of 73 million patient visits. Today, we support over 2.5 million patient sessions a week across 190+ countries.

Healthcare systems are failing us; clinicians spend more time on documentation than on patients, and the human connection that makes medicine worth practicing is eroding. Our mission is simple: double the world's healthcare capacity and strengthen the human connection at its heart.

We found product-market fit with a freemium medical scribe that clinicians love. Now, we're expanding. Every task a clinician hands to Heidi is a patient who feels more attended to, a health system unclogged, and a clinician who gets to be a clinician again.

If you don't choose easy and you want to build something way bigger than yourself, we might be a good place for you to start.

Our perspective on GTM

We believe that sales has fundamentally changed in the last 6 months. The repetitive work is automated now: AI does the market research, drafts the emails, summarises and scores the calls.

The last year has taught us that the people who succeed have a blend of the following traits.

  • Intellectual dexterity: consultant-like ability to structure and break down a problem into its constituent parts, think from first principles, and self-improve rapidly. Inherent curiosity goes a long way here.

  • Natural charisma: can build rapport with anyone. You work out quickly who you're talking to, what they're dealing with and what they actually need, then have the conversation that gets you both somewhere.

  • Drive & focus: as AI commoditises intelligence, work ethic and agency matter more. An outlier candidate here is far more productive than the mean than they were two years ago, and the gap keeps widening.

  • The mark of humanity: in a world filling up with AI slop, work where you can feel the person behind it stands out. Where the copy, the imagery, and the strategy is indelibly human.

We don't think the talent market has caught up with how GTM is changing, so we’re open minded - title or experience isn’t important. Most of our team started outside the profession: VC, consulting and creative are common.

This role is high leverage, highly rewarding, and intellectually stimulating. We want you to be part of that.

The role

Heidi sits in an unusual position. We lead a category being built for the first time. Hundreds of thousands of clinicians found us on their own, started using the product for free and told a colleague. The market is genuinely open and the clinicians in it already like the product. Your job is to turn that quiet enthusiasm into real revenue conversations.

You're the first line to Heidi. Inbound demand and product signals point you at practices and hospital groups already using us, and you decide whether to qualify each one in, out, or close it yourself. The signals tell you who to reach out to, you decide how.

This is the first rung of our UK sales org, and for most clinicians you'll be the first person from Heidi they ever speak to. How they feel about us afterwards is largely down to you. You'll triage the inbound to your Account Executive's where it belongs and close your own deals from day one, because we want people as close to the frontline as possible. You'll build a network across UK healthcare that outlasts the role.

What this means practically:

  • Work the inbound queue and the warm product signals. Your day goes to clinicians and practices already using Heidi, where the product tells you who's outgrown the free version

  • Research the accounts behind those signals, work out who else in the practice or hospital group needs to be in the conversation, and build the angle for each one

  • Reach the people the signals point to, across calls, email and social, while the interest is still fresh

  • Book demos and meetings for your AEs with enough context that nothing is lost in the handoff

  • Own small SMB deals end to end, from first conversation through to closed

  • Keep the CRM accurate, keep the pipeline moving and hit your qualified-lead number every month

  • Partner with AEs, Marketing, Product, Operations and Customer Success so what you promise on the call matches what clinicians get

  • Track what's shifting in UK healthcare and across the competitive set, then tell the team what you're hearing on the phones

What you'll need

  • You've worked somewhere with a high bar, whether that's tech, creative, banking, consulting or PE/VC. We care more about what you've achieved than any time in a sales role.

  • You care about what we do. You'd rather learn how the product actually works than memorise a pitch.

  • You can hold a conversation with anyone and get to the point of it fast. Clinicians have twenty patients before lunch. You respect that and still get the meeting.

  • Organised and autonomously functioning. You run your own list, your own day and your own follow-ups without being chased.

  • Passion for AI, shown through hands-on building, prototyping, or side projects.

  • You default to building over requesting.

  • You're confident in your thinking and open to being wrong. Great ideas win regardless of who surfaces them.

Attitude beats experience here. If you're hungry, competitive and you like solving the problem in front of you, we want to hear from you.

How we show up

  • Build for the next decade, not next quarter. Our targets are outrageous on purpose. The world's health doesn't have the luxury of incrementalism.

  • Lead, don't wait. We treat tomorrow's problems today. Sometimes we build what's needed before it's wanted, and we're fine with that.

  • Follow the evidence. Trust the patient. We pursue truth relentlessly. But when the subjective and objective disagree, we treat the patient, not the numbers. Ego is a comorbidity we can't afford.

  • Own the outcome. Everyone here carries the company. Raise problems with solutions, solve them end-to-end, and never be a bystander.

  • Ship, measure, go again. A button today, a workflow tomorrow. More iterations beat better planning. We're precise at pace, not reckless.

  • Live in clinicians' reality. Not the ideal workflow, the twenty-patients-before-lunch actual one. We build for exhausted humans, and we'd better be decent ones while we do it.

Why Heidi?

You'll join a team focused on real-world impact over imaginary valuations and glossy PR. We live and breathe the challenges of modern health systems, and are laser-focused on exacting the change we'd like to see. We're medicos, engineers, builders, and designers who've felt the moral and practical toll of what non-care feels like. True A-players progress extremely fast here. The nature of the scale-up game is demanding, but we value sustainable performance and mental health. You're trusted to perform, and you set your schedule. We operate on outcomes > inputs, not process theatre. We all take the bins out, metaphorically and literally.

Building what we're building isn't always easy. But we didn't choose easy, we chose to build something that actually matters. We hold ourselves to a higher standard because healthcare demands it. If you join Heidi, you recognise that the deeper question isn't whether AI can solve the global healthcare crisis, but whose hands will shape it. The work is hard, but you will trust and admire the people you work beside, and rest easy knowing you're doing the defining work of your career.

We take care of you

We offer comprehensive private medical and dental cover through Bupa, 24/7 mental health, coaching and wellbeing support through Sonder, a £100/month Healthy Heidi's wellness stipend, a £500 home office budget, a £700 annual learning and development budget, 26 weeks paid primary parental leave and 18 weeks paid secondary parental leave, fertility support up to £7,000, up to four weeks of work from anywhere per year, Recharge Days after major milestones and busy periods, 10 days per year of clinical leave for eligible clinical roles, and a hybrid working environment with 3 days in the office.

We chose to open-source our benefits hub, if you care to take a peek.

description:
Synthesia is the world’s leading AI video platform for business, used by over 90% of the Fortune 100. Founded in 2017, the company is headquartered in London, with offices and teams across Europe and the US.

As AI continues to shape the way we live and work, Synthesia develops products to enhance visual communication and enterprise skill development, helping people work better and stay at the center of successful organizations.

Following our recent Series E funding round, where we raised $200 million, our valuation stands at $4 billion. Our total funding exceeds $530 million from premier investors including Accel, NVentures (Nvidia's VC arm), Kleiner Perkins, GV, and Evantic Capital, alongside the founders and operators of Stripe, Datadog, Miro, and Webflow.

Why this job posting

We are always on the lookout for exceptional talent.

The best hires rarely arrive the moment a perfectly matching job posting happens to be live. So we're not waiting. You might not fit one of our current open roles, and that's fine. If you're genuinely great at what you do, we want you, and we'll find work for you!

Tell us what you're brilliant at and where you'd have the most impact, and we'll figure out the right seat together.

What it's like to work here

A few things that are true about working here:

We move fast. Really fast. Hours and days, not weeks or months.

We keep it light. Few meetings, little bureaucracy, less talking and more doing. And we default to doing it ourselves before adding dependencies, because pulling other people in slows everything down for everyone.

We hold a high bar. Average loses. Even good often does. We're here to do the best work of our careers, and we back each other to get there, low ego, high trust.

It's not an easy game. We're in AI, the most competitive space in the world, and nobody is going to give us this market. We have to take it.

But the impact is real. You'll see your work land. If you want to build things you're proud of, this is the place.

Where you might fit

We hire top talent across the whole function. A few of the areas where you might fit:

  • Performance. Own paid end to end and turn spend into pipeline and revenue.

  • Growth. Own the experiments and loops that compound over time.

  • Field. Own the events and 1:1 and 1:few plays that accelerate deals by region.

  • SEO. Win traditional and AI search. Ship the best content and world-class landing pages.

  • Brand and Creative. Make Synthesia impossible to ignore.

  • Copywriting. Write copy that lands. Make every word earn its place.

  • Organic Social. Build organic presence across platforms. Go viral with content people love.

  • Product and Customer Marketing. Position it. Launch it. Tell the story.

  • Lifecycle. Turn new signups into engaged customers who stick and grow.

  • Analytics and Measurement. Turn data into the team's sharpest decisions.

Not seeing your exact discipline? Apply anyway and tell us where you'd have the most impact.

About you

  • You get results. Pipeline, adoption, revenue. You can point to the numbers.

  • You live in the data. You reach for the numbers and tell signal from noise.

  • You can write. Sharp positioning and copy, with a point of view you'll defend.

  • You own it. Blank slate, your call. You move and adjust based on what works.

  • You run solo. You get things done without pulling in a crowd.

  • You adapt fast. Priorities shift, channels change, AI rewrites the playbook. You keep up.

  • You love AI. You want to build a category-defining product at one of the fastest-growing AI companies in the world.

Apply

Apply here. In a line or two, tell us where you fit and what you'd want to own. We review on a rolling basis, and when there's a match with a current or upcoming role, we'll reach out. What you share stays with us for future openings too.

Want to skip the queue? Message Borys Khodan, VP of Marketing, on LinkedIn and make your case:

  • Where you'd have the most impact. A few sharp bullet points.

  • What you're proudest of. Real wins, with the numbers behind them.

Show us the work. That's what gets our attention.

Data Scientist - Partner Flow Team
description:
Data Scientist - Partner Flow

Hybrid in London, United Kingdom

We're looking for a Data Scientist to join the Partner Flow team

You'll own experimentation and analytics for iwoca's partner channel – fintechs and platforms that embed iwoca lending in their own products. The analytical approach is still being built, and the scope to shape it is wide.

The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don't wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that's as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We've already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

The team

Partner Flow owns the customer journey from the moment someone starts an application on a partner platform through to a completed credit assessment. By making the application process as smooth as possible and collecting the data needed for a credit decision efficiently, the team maximises the number of partner-referred customers that receive an offer. The team works across the full application stack – from the APIs partners use to integrate iwoca, through to the experience customers see when they apply.

The team is small and cross-functional, combining data science, engineering, design, and product. Active projects include:

  • Pre-qualification – testing how showing customers an offer before they apply affects conversion and long-term value

  • Credit card strategy – iwoca recently launched a credit card alongside its flexi-loan; the team is working out which product, or combination, to offer which customers

  • Funnel optimisation – identifying and reducing the biggest points of friction across the partner journey

The role

You'll design experiments, model customer behaviour and analyse large data sets across the partner funnel, and turn findings into product and strategy decisions. The analytical approach is still being shaped - you'll influence how it develops, not just what it produces.

The work has direct commercial consequences – on partner platforms, iwoca competes for attention alongside other lenders, and what this team builds and tests affects which customers convert and on what terms. You'll work closely with commercial, strategy, and product colleagues across the business.

  • Experimentation and causal inference. You'll design and analyse experiments where careful randomisation and interpretation are critical. You'll need to know where standard A/B testing breaks down and what to reach for instead. The problems are consequential: measuring how pre-qualification affects Customer Lifetime Value (CLTV), and understanding how different products interact when offered to the same customer base.

  • Funnel and competitive strategy. You'll analyse the full partner-referred customer journey – from application through to credit assessment – identifying where conversion breaks down and why. On partner platforms, iwoca is positioned alongside competitors, so you'll also figure out what makes customers choose iwoca over the alternatives, and how to shift those dynamics in our favour.

  • Commercial translation. You'll be directly involved when decisions get made – not handing off analysis to be interpreted by someone else. You'll work with commercial and strategy colleagues and coordinate with adjacent teams to make sure the tests and policies you run fit together with their ongoing work.

  • AI and ways of working. You'll use AI to accelerate and automate your analytical work. The team treats this as a lever for increasing its rate of learning. You'll be expected to have a view on where it helps and where it doesn't.

The requirements

Essential:

  • Statistical foundations. Strong grounding in probability and statistics, with an understanding of Bayesian reasoning and experience applying hierarchical modelling or decision-making under uncertainty.

  • Causal inference. Experience separating signal from noise in observational and experimental data.

  • Business translation. Ability to understand commercial context and translate data into actionable insights that guide decisions - not just produce analysis, but land it with people who act on it.

  • Data tooling. Proficiency with data manipulation and modelling tools.

  • Analytical ownership. Comfortable owning ambiguous problems end-to-end - from framing through modelling to influencing decisions.

  • AI fluency. Experience with and a passion for using AI to accelerate and automate analysis and model building.

  • Communication. You write and speak clearly, adapting technical detail to different audiences.

Bonus:

  • Modelling depth. Experience building or adapting statistical or ML models, with an interest in understanding what's happening underneath.

  • Stochastic methods. Familiarity with stochastic modelling concepts as they apply to inference, time series, or uncertainty.

  • Funnel and marketplace experience. Experience with conversion funnel analysis or marketplace dynamics where you're competing for attention alongside competitors.

  • Python. You work primarily in Python. If your background is R or another language, that's fine - but Python is what the team uses day to day.

  • Market curiosity. You want to understand how the partner lending market actually works - what makes a partner choose iwoca over a competitor, and what makes a customer convert.

The salary

We expect to pay from £70,000 – £80,000 for this role. But, we’re open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance reviews.

The culture

At iwoca, the best idea wins. We model our culture on independent thinking, challenging untested logic, and evidence-based decisions. We prioritise learning and growth, and give people the autonomy to develop in the direction that makes them most effective.

We're a tech company and believe in the power of AI to help us work faster and better. We provide the infrastructure where every iwocan always has access to the best models and where those models have access to all of our data. We will help our people to learn how to use and grow with the new tools available to them.

The offices

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

  • Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

  • Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

The benefits

  • Flexible working hours.

  • Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership.

  • A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents.

  • 25 days’ holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave.

  • A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years.

  • Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support.

  • 3% Pension contributions on total earnings.

  • An employee equity incentive scheme.

  • Generous parental leave and a nursery tax benefit scheme to help you save money.

  • Electric car scheme and cycle to work scheme.

  • Two company retreats a year: we’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield.

And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer:

  • A learning and development budget for everyone.

  • Company-wide talks with internal and external speakers.

  • Access to learning platforms like Treehouse.

description:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

You will own partnerships for ElevenCreative across the agency and platform ecosystem.

Marketing, creative, and performance teams are rapidly changing how they produce advertising and content, and much of that work reaches brands through agencies and through the platforms those teams already use every day. This role sits at that intersection.

ElevenCreative is our AI creative platform, where creators and marketers generate and edit speech, music, image, and video using leading AI models.   • Build scalable partner motions, including enablement, co-selling, referrals, and joint go-to-market programs.

  • Develop a deep understanding of how agencies make money, where they create margin and differentiation, and how AI can strengthen their value to clients.

  • Stay close to the evolving AI creative landscape, customer use cases, competitive dynamics, and emerging distribution models.

  • Use partner and customer feedback to help shape product priorities and identify where ElevenCreative should invest.

  • Represent ElevenCreative with partners at industry events, conferences, executive meetings, and customer conversations.

About The Role and Team

Quantum Motion is a fast-growing quantum computing scale-up based in London founded by internationally renowned researchers from UCL and Oxford University with over 40 years’ experience in developing qubits and quantum computing architectures. Bringing together state-of-the-art cryogenic facilities and an outstanding interdisciplinary team, we are developing quantum processors based on industrial-grade silicon chips, with the potential to radically transform computing power in areas such as materials modelling, medicine, artificial intelligence and more.


Our Team

Since 2021 our team has been listed every year in the “Top 100 Startups worth watching” in the EE Times, and our technology breakthroughs have been featured in The Telegraph, BBC and the New Statesman. Our founders are internationally renowned researchers from UCL and Oxford University who have pioneered the development of qubits and quantum computing architectures. Our chairman is the co-founder of Cadence and Synopsys, the two leading companies in the area of Electronic Design Automation. We’re backed by a team of top-tier investors, and we have recently closed our Series C funding of $160 million.

We bring together the brightest quantum engineers, integrated circuit (IC) engineers, quantum computing theoreticians and software engineers to create a unique, world-leading team, working together closely to maximise our combined expertise. Our collaborative and interdisciplinary culture is an ideal fit for anyone who thrives in a cutting-edge research and development environment focused on tackling big challenges and contributing to the development of scalable quantum computers based on silicon technology.

As Director of Systems Delivery, you will build and lead the function responsible for the complete lifecycle of Quantum Motion’s full-stack silicon quantum systems, from initial programme planning, build, and integration through commissioning, acceptance testing, and handover. 

You will drive cross-functional alignment across hardware, software, systems integration, and operations. Key priorities include establishing delivery playbooks, acceptance protocols, and customer site infrastructure readiness, while synchronising complex silicon bring-up with agile software developments.

  • Acceptance Testing & Governance: Implement delivery schedules, risk management, and formal acceptance testing protocols.

  • Supply Chain Management: Manage technical hardware procurement, key vendor relationships, and supplier performance supporting delivery timelines.                                                                  

  • Commercial Scoping Support: Provide technical scoping, feasibility input, and operational planning for commercial proposals while fostering team accountability.

  • Must have proven experience managing physical hardware systems (e.g., quantum, semiconductor, aerospace, or advanced scientific instrumentation) with a realistic understanding of physical build constraints and lead times.
